item.title: DACC receives grant to add mental health services
item.description: DANVILLE, Ill. (WCIA) -- Danville Area Community College (DACC) is putting a new grant to good use. After being awarded $78,000 from the Illinois Community College Board, DACC said it plans to improve mental health services campus-wide. The school is partnering with online therapy apps for students and CrossPoint Human Services, which is a crisis hotline. [...]
